description: Use when the venue owner asks to change products on their own menu: price, name, description, ingredients, allergens, availability (sold out / back) or featured. Identify products by product_id from get_my_menu; if several products match what the owner said (for example two with the same name), ask which one. Up to 50 products per call. Two steps: call first without confirm to get the before/after (nothing is saved), show it to the owner, and only after they agree call again with the same changes and confirm: true. Allergens: only the 14 EU codes and only when the owner states them; never guess. Changed texts are translated automatically. Every change can be undone with undo_change. Requires the owner to connect their PRENOTO account. Reply in the owner's language.

allergens.description: Full new list of allergens (replaces the current one). Only what the owner states.

available.description: false = sold out / hidden from the public menu; true = shown again.

description.description: Empty string or null removes it.

ingredients.description: Empty string or null removes it.

price.description: New price in the venue currency, without symbol.

confirm.description: false or omitted: preview only. true: save, only after the owner agreed to the preview.

venue_id.description: Optional. Only needed when the account manages several venues (see list_my_venues).

name: update_products
title: Change products
